seoTitle: Douglas County School District Calendar 2026–27 | Key Dates
seoDescription: View the DCSD 2026–27 calendar, including the August 12 first day, May 27 last day, school breaks, PLC delayed starts, and the official PDF.
heroSourceLine: 2026–27 calendar dates · Based on official DCSD calendar sources
verificationBadgeText: Checked against official DCSD calendar sources on August 5, 2026.
schemaDatasetDescription: Reviewed Douglas County School District dates for 2026–27, including conventional-calendar school breaks, no-student days, PLC delayed-start dates, the official color PDF, and the official text/list view PDF.
heroSummary:
Douglas County School District students begin the 2026–27 school year on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, and finish on Thursday, May 27, 2027. The conventional calendar includes 173 student days. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–31, and Spring Break is March 15–19. Students return after Winter Break on Tuesday, January 5, following a teacher work day on January 4.

DCSD also uses Friday delayed starts during the 2026–27 school year. District-operated elementary and middle schools begin 45 minutes later; see the full PLC schedule below.
calendarNotes: This page covers DCSD’s conventional academic calendar. Most DCSD schools follow the conventional calendar, but Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars. PLC Fridays are regular attendance days with a 45-minute delayed start for DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools; high schools continue their existing Friday schedule, and buses run 45 minutes later. Check your school for exact times.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2025–26
content: The first student day moves from August 13 in 2025–26 to August 12 in 2026–27.
Spring Break shifts from March 16–20 in 2025–26 to March 15–19 in 2026–27.
The last student day moves from May 29 in 2025–26 to May 27 in 2026–27.
The 2026–27 calendar introduces 45-minute Friday delayed starts for district-operated elementary and middle schools. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules.

customSections.label: DCSD Friday Delayed Starts
customSections.content: Beginning in the 2026–27 school year, DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools start 45 minutes later every Friday for Professional Learning Community time. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules, and school buses also run 45 minutes later. Check your school for its exact bell time and before-school care arrangements. Charter schools may follow different schedules.

table.footnote: Dates were transcribed from the PLC markers in DCSD’s official color calendar PDF. Check your school for its exact Friday bell schedule.

customSections.label: Calendar Exceptions
customSections.content: Most DCSD schools follow this conventional calendar. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish their own calendars. Families at those schools should confirm dates directly with the school.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school in DCSD for 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The first student day on the DCSD conventional calendar is Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. May 28 is a teacher work day with no students.

calendarFaqs.q: When are fall, winter, and spring breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is October 12–16, 2026; Winter Break is December 21–31, 2026; and Spring Break is March 15–19, 2027. Students return after Winter Break on January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a PLC delayed-start day?
calendarFaqs.a: Students still attend school on PLC Fridays, but DCSD-operated elementary and middle schools start 45 minutes later and buses run 45 minutes later. High schools continue their existing Friday delayed-start schedules; check your school for its exact bell time.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are on the calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: DCSD’s conventional calendar lists 173 student days for 2026–27.

calendarFaqs.q: Does every DCSD school follow this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against DCSD’s academic calendars page, color calendar, list-view calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and Professional Learning Communities guidance. The 2025–26 calendar was also reviewed for the year-over-year comparison.
sourceReviewDetails: The current color PDF footer says “Approved by the Board of Education: June 18, 2024.” The DCSD academic calendars page currently displays “Approved by the DCSD Board of Education June 9, 2026.” Because the two official DCSD sources show different approval dates, we list both dates here until the district updates or clarifies the record.

We compared the major breaks and no-school dates across DCSD’s calendar landing page, color calendar, Calendar at a Glance, and list-view PDF. Where official sources use different wording, we note the discrepancy rather than silently choosing one label.

DCSD’s official sources use different labels for February 12, 2027. The list-view PDF calls it a Compensation Day with schools closed, while Calendar at a Glance calls it a Professional Development Day with no students. Both sources agree that students do not attend school.

PLC delayed-start dates were read from the light-blue PLC markers in the official color PDF. DCSD’s Professional Learning Communities page explains the 45-minute elementary and middle school delay and later bus schedules; families should confirm exact bell times with their school.
Renaissance Elementary Magnet School, Daniel C. Oakes High School, Eagle Academy, and DCSD charter schools may publish separate calendars.
